description:
Subject: Linkerd‑Viz Deployment Configuration

The Linkerd‑Viz service has been configured to run with 1.5 CPU shares and 1 GB (1024 MB) of memory. It will be reachable on public port 3000, while the backend statistics are exposed on port 9191. The deployment is targeted to agents that carry the **slave_public** resource role, ensuring the service is placed on a public node. Additionally, the UI integration with DC/OS is enabled, so the dashboard can be accessed directly from the DC/OS “Open Service” button at `http://DCOS_URL/service/linkerd-viz`.
